answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Reaching the copper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the raven of the next round.
